subject: MedForcure — scoped log retention & attestation
messages:
From: Oliver Green <security@medforcure.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request — scoped log retention & CAIQ/SIG evidence

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our procurement checklist we need to understand Redwood's practical retention profile for conversational and debug traces, and whether customer-specific exceptions are possible. A few specific asks from our security/compliance team: 

- For inference traces and session transcripts: default TTL, any per-tenant overrides, and examples of when data would be retained beyond default.
- For low-level debug/telemetry (stack traces, SDK logs): default TTL and whether these can be excluded from long-term storage or auto-purged.
- Process for handling legal holds / SARs that require preserving logs beyond TTL.
- Evidence: CAIQ/SIG mappings where log retention fields are identified, and any signed attestation templates Redwood can provide for customers asking for a retention carve-out.

I attached our partial SIG spreadsheet to indicate the specific questions we need answered (MedForcure_SIG.xlsx). Can you provide a matrix and the expected evidence delivery timeline? We are aiming to close contract review with procurement by Oct 20.

Appreciate it — cc'd Lina from procurement who will track contract questions.

Best,
Oliver
Security Lead, MedForcure Ltd

Attachments: MedForcure_SIG.xlsx (questionnaire)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Green <security@medforcure.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Oct 2025 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request — scoped log retention & CAIQ/SIG evidence

Hi Oliver — thanks for sending this over and for the timeline.

Short answer up front: yes, Redwood supports per-tenant retention adjustments and can provide CAIQ/SIG crosswalks plus a signed attestation for the retention carve-out you describe. Below is a concise matrix; I've attached a more detailed spreadsheet (redwood-log-retention-matrix.xlsx) with exact field mappings and sample API payloads for setting tenant TTLs.

Summary matrix (short):
- Conversational transcripts: default TTL = 30 days. Per-tenant override: configurable to 7–365 days via customer config API or via support request for >365.
- Inference artifacts (model inputs/outputs): default TTL = 30 days; can be disabled for PII-sensitive flows (opt-out at account level).
- Debug/SDK logs: default TTL = 14 days; can be set to 0 (no retention) for customer-managed agents, or routed to customer-owned S3 for long-term storage.
- Legal hold / SARs: legal hold flags suspend automated deletion; Redwood will preserve flagged records until release and provide a manifest/export.

We can produce: (a) CAIQ/SIG mapping with the relevant retention control IDs, (b) a signed retention attestation (PDF), and (c) a tailored retention matrix for MedForcure. Estimated delivery: 3 business days for the mapping + matrix, 5 business days for signed attestation.

Next steps: 1) quick 30-min call to confirm whether MedForcure needs >365-day exceptions or an escrow-style handoff, 2) we'll drop the deliverables into the Drive link and share DocuSign for the attestation.

Attaching: redwood-log-retention-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet) — includes the CAIQ/CCM IDs, SOC2 control references, API examples.

Talk soon,
Naomi
Sr. Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-log-retention-matrix.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Green <security@medforcure.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2025 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request — scoped log retention & CAIQ/SIG evidence

Hi Oliver — copying in a little more detail from Security so you have language you can share with your compliance team and with procurement.

Policy excerpt (operational):
"Redwood default data retention periods are conservative and aim to support incident investigation while minimizing exposed surface area. Customers may configure tenant-level retention windows via the Admin API. By default, non-production debug traces are retained for 14 days; application-level conversational transcripts and model inputs/outputs are retained for 30 days. For customers with regulatory requirements, Redwood supports: (1) account-level TTL increases up to 365 days via self-serve config, (2) exceptions beyond 365 days through a documented approval + attestation process, and (3) migrating or forwarding debug logs to customer-owned storage. Legal holds triggered by SARs or litigation will suspend regular deletion and are tracked via an auditable hold manifest."

Signed attestation: we prepared a short draft attestation document that lists the retention behaviour and carve-out workflow; if MedForcure requires a custom attestation we can finalize, sign, and DocuSign. I attached a draft (retention-attestation-draft.pdf).

Notes on evidence and delivery:
- CAIQ/SIG crosswalk: includes ID mapping to CC3.1/CC6.2 style controls for log retention.
- SOC 2: we will point to our SOC 2 evidence packet for retention & disposition controls; where SOC evidence is insufficient for a customer-specific carve-out we will provide the attestation + operational runbook.
- For EU customers: we can provide a data-flow diagram and Keystore residency statement specific to your region.

If it's helpful, Marissa from compliance can coordinate the DocuSign and legal routing.

Kimberly Park
Head of Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference

Attachments: retention-attestation-draft.pdf

From: Oliver Green <security@medforcure.com>

Subject: Re: Request — scoped log retention & CAIQ/SIG evidence

Naomi / Kimberly — thank you, this is very helpful and much more concrete than we expected. A couple quick clarifying items before we route to legal/procurement: 

1) For the >365-day exceptions path: can you confirm whether Redwood requires a contract addendum, or whether the signed attestation alone is sufficient? Procurement prefers a short contract rider.
2) For debug logs forwarded to customer S3: is the forwarding real-time streaming or a scheduled batch export? We need details for our ingestion pipeline.
3) Timeline: we'd like the CAIQ/SIG crosswalk and the log-retention-matrix by Thu Oct 16; if DocuSign for the attestation can be ready the same week, procurement can close by Oct 20.

If those delivery dates look feasible, please send the Drive link and a DocuSign placeholder and we'll queue legal review. Thanks again — cc'ing Lina.

Best,
Oliver
